{{Quote|Gold Squadron, let's go create a diversion.|Saesee Tiin at the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]]|<ref name="Obsession 4" />}}
'''Gold Squadron''', also called '''Gold Group''' or '''Gold Team''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the early stages of the conflict, Gold Squadron's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] flew [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], while its [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7]] and [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]. Later in the war, Gold Squadron pilots flew [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]].

==History==
{{Quote|A gold droid for Gold leader of Gold Squadron.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], regarding [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]]|audio=GoldGoldGold-DoaD.flac|<ref name="DoaD" />}}
[[File:Anakins_Delta-7B_wreckage.png|thumb|left|250px|Gold Leader Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B starfighter took heavy damage over Bothawui]]
Stationed aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] under the command of [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Gold Squadron [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|lured]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] into a trap set in an [[asteroid field]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] ordered his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to break off, Skywalker pursued the fleeing Grievous, taking damage to [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] and losing the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the process. Upon presenting him with a replacement, the gold-colored [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], Anakin's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] commented that it was only appropriate for Skywalker, as Gold Leader of Gold Squadron, to possess a golden [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="DoaD" />

A group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptors]], known as Gold Group or Gold Team, arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to take part in the [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|defense]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. On the orders of [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], they launched an attack run on the Separatist [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnought]] [[Subjugator (Subjugator-class)|''Subjugator'']], successfully bringing down its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="Kinect">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

[[File:Gold_Squad_Obsession_4.jpg|right|thumb|Saesee Tiin's Gold Squadron launching from ''Intervention'']]
During the latter stages of the Clone Wars, Gold Squadron was outfitted with [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]], and commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. During the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]], Tiin led Gold Squadron out of ''[[Intervention]]''{{'s}} hangar and into combat against a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class cruiser]] above [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], in a diversionary tactic that gave [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] strike team time to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and track down [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="Obsession 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
A pilot named "Gold Six" is mentioned in the sound that plays while the [[Lucasfilm]] logo is displayed at the opening of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]. This snippet, used in the episode [[Downfall of a Droid]], does not tie in to the film's storyline.
